mission_02: Do-calculus, developed by Judea Pearl, provides a complete set of three rules for transforming interventional distributions (containing do-operators) into observational distributions that can be estimated from data. Rule 1 allows inserting or deleting observations when variables are conditionally independent. Rule 2 allows exchanging actions (interventions) with observations under certain independence conditions. Rule 3 allows inserting or deleting actions when the intervention has no effect on the outcome. In this mission, you will implement functions to check when each rule applies by constructing modified graphs (removing incoming edges to intervened variables) and testing d-separation. Mastering do-calculus is essential for determining whether a causal effect is identifiable from observational data.
